meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The 04:00 Ghost Drill
quests.narrative_guidance: Assist Commander Virek in repelling a simulated breach during training drills while he obsessively reviews logs.
improvisation_points: Report to Commander Virek Alpha at the Plaza for the 04:00 log review.
Obtain filter bypass codes from Technician Rilo Alpha.
Submit the breach suppression report to AI Sentinel Prime.

quests.title: Filter Emergency
quests.narrative_guidance: Repair and recalibrate sensor arrays under emergency conditions in the steam tunnels.
improvisation_points: Collect calibration tools from Technician Rilo Beta.
Apply symbolic protective markings with Engineer Tamsin Beta.
Confirm efficiency ratings with Analyst Nove Beta.

quests.title: The Phantom Fleet Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: Bypass AI Overseer Sentinel’s false alerts to access sensitive data regarding void movements.
improvisation_points: Extract the 'false alert' pattern from AI Sentinel Gamma.
Negotiate access through the Dead Zone with Liaison Katt Gamma.
Synchronize the data with Scout Drone Omega-3.

quests.title: Ghost in the Machine
quests.narrative_guidance: Track and tag Scout Drone Omega for rogue behavior analysis after it reports phantom objects in the spires.
improvisation_points: Intercept Scout Drone Omega-1's ghost signal.
Consult Commander Virek Beta for historical anomaly logs.
Deliver the drone's memory core to Technician Rilo Gamma.

quests.title: The High-Profile Breach
quests.narrative_guidance: Coordinate with Mercenary Liaison Katt to intercept a potential infiltration attempt at the Iron Gate.
improvisation_points: Receive the tactical briefing from Liaison Katt Prime.
Verify security signatures with AI Sentinel Beta.
Ensure shield integrity with Engineer Tamsin Alpha.

quests.title: Shield of Symbols
quests.narrative_guidance: Maintain Shield Generator Core operation during a simulated power failure using encoded markings.
improvisation_points: Receive the symbolic blueprint from Engineer Tamsin Gamma.
Verify power usage patterns with Analyst Nove Alpha.
Clear the area of unauthorized contractors with Liaison Katt Beta.

quests.title: The Coffee-Orbital Correlation
quests.narrative_guidance: Analyze orbital anomalies and produce a predictive report based on personnel efficiency.
improvisation_points: Collect the coffee consumption data from Analyst Nove Gamma.
Retrieve the phantom object logs from Scout Drone Omega-2.
Submit the final predictive report to Commander Virek Gamma.

quests.title: The Phantasmal Breach
quests.narrative_guidance: A simulated breach has spiraled out of control. You must verify the authenticity of the threat across multiple sectors.
improvisation_points: Consult Virek-Alpha about the 04:00 sensor logs.
Verify the holographic integrity with Sentinel-Edge.
Submit a seismic resonance report to Nove-Reach to confirm no ground-shaking occurred.

quests.title: Calibrating the Void
quests.narrative_guidance: The optical sensors are failing. A coordinated recalibration is required to maintain the Aegis vision.
improvisation_points: Acquire the specialized lens filters from Rilo-Prime.
Deliver the flux-capacitors to Tamsin-M to power the array.
Confirm the long-range visuals with Omega-03.

quests.title: The False Signal
quests.narrative_guidance: A ghost signal is bypassing the central AI. You must trace the origin through the mercenary network.
improvisation_points: Intercept the ghost packet from Sentinel-Core.
Consult with Katt-Deep to see if the Cartel is using the frequency.
Report the breach findings to Virek-Gamma for perimeter lockdown.

quests.title: Deep Pressure Drift
quests.narrative_guidance: Sensors in the Mantle are detecting movement in the heat that shouldn't be there.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the thermal logs from Omega-02.
Request turret support from Rilo-Rim to cover the vents.
Finalize the security contract with Katt-V to bring in extra guards.

quests.title: The Shielding Secret
quests.narrative_guidance: The buffer zone's shields are fluctuating. You need to decode the maintenance symbols.
improvisation_points: Obtain the cipher key from Tamsin-A's markings.
Cross-reference the efficiency logs with Nove-One.
Upload the fix to the Valve District flow controller Sentinel-V3.

quests.title: Mercenary's Gambit
quests.narrative_guidance: A shipment of illegal pulse pistols has been detected moving through the trenches.
improvisation_points: Meet Katt-Rim to get the shipment manifest.
Search the deep shafts with Virek-Beta for the hidden stash.
Reinforce the garrison gates with Tamsin-Z to prevent export.

quests.title: Orbital Prediction
quests.narrative_guidance: Atmospheric pressure changes suggest a massive orbital object is descending.
improvisation_points: Get the threat probability from Nove-Seven.
Deploy Omega-01 to get a high-altitude visual.
Hand the coordinates to Rilo-Mantle for emergency pressure venting.

quests.title: The 04:00 Anomaly
quests.narrative_guidance: Commander Virek has noticed a discrepancy in the morning sensor logs that requires a physical inspection of the kilns.
improvisation_points: Obtain the log discrepancy report from Commander Virek Prime at the Eye of the Dome.
Take the report to Technician Rilo Core in the Refinement Kilns to cross-reference heat signatures.
Deliver the final diagnostic to Sentinel C-1 in the Barrack Blocks to update the defensive subroutines.

quests.title: Shadow Logistics
quests.narrative_guidance: Liaison Katt suspects that resources are being diverted through the pressure chambers and requires an engineering audit.
improvisation_points: Receive the smuggling manifest from Liaison Katt Prime in the Command Tier.
Have Engineer Tamsin Core decrypt the manifest using her symbolic pressure codes.
Present the evidence of the leak to Analyst Nove-Gamma at the Perimeter Trench.

quests.title: The Ghost in the Cliffs
quests.narrative_guidance: Scout Drone Omega-03 has detected a phantom signature that requires the central archive's history files to identify.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the phantom signal coordinates from Unit Omega-03 at the Radar Cliffs.
Analyze the signal data against historical logs with Sentinel A-1 in the Archive Vaults.
Update the flak battery targeting lenses with Technician Rilo Aegis to prevent false-positive fire.

quests.title: Efficiency Protocol Beta
quests.narrative_guidance: Analyst Nove-Alpha has detected a lag in response times that requires a liaison's enforcement at the border.
improvisation_points: Pick up the efficiency audit from Analyst Nove-Alpha in the Sensor Fields.
Deliver the enforcement orders to Liaison Katt Aegis at the Landing Pads.
Submit the enforcement report to Commander Virek Core at The Maw for final approval.

quests.title: Synthetic Purity Drill
quests.narrative_guidance: Sentinel B-1 is running a sector-wide stress test and needs a scout to verify the physical logic gate integrity.
improvisation_points: Accept the simulation parameters from Sentinel B-1 in the Piston Slums.
Verify the physical gateway security with Unit Omega-01 at the Logic Gates.
Report the simulation results to Commander Virek Aegis at the Shield Wall.

quests.title: The Lens of Truth
quests.narrative_guidance: Technician Rilo Apex requires data from the industrial foundries to fix a permanent smudge on the primary sensor array.
improvisation_points: Get the calibration lens from Technician Rilo Apex at the Signal Spire.
Compare the lens coating with mineral samples from Analyst Nove-Beta at the Geodesic Foundries.
Hand over the corrected lens to Liaison Katt Core at the Ore Belts for transport back to Apex Primary.

quests.title: Interrogation Cipher
quests.narrative_guidance: Engineer Tamsin Aegis has hidden a key within a shield mural that is needed to track a thermal ghost in the core.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the symbolic key from Engineer Tamsin Aegis in the Interrogation Cells.
Use the key to unlock the thermal tracking unit held by Unit Omega-02 at the Heat Sinks.
File the tracking data with Commander Virek Prime at the Eye of the Dome.
